english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an indoor sports or large entertainment arena.
Use this when the facility is understood as an indoor sports hall or a named sports venue.

examples.english: The concert is being held in the arena tonight.
examples.traditional: 今晚演唱會喺體育館舉行。
